_note: robofast PWI server (Alpaca Telescope + Focuser + Rotator) for MINERVA T2, through an SSH tunnel: docs/pwi.md, docs/remote.md.
PWI4 is NOT INSTALLED on the telescope PCs yet: this config is for after the cutover in minerva-control docs/pwi4.md.
PWI is reached on 127.0.0.1:7142 (PWI4); the tunnel's far end is the telescope's control PC, set up by the operator, not here.
allow_hardware is true, but nothing talks to the real PWI without --hardware on the command line as well (robofast_core/hwgate.py).
Limits (deg): min_alt = legacy telescope_N.ini HORIZON (21), max_alt = legacy scheduler.ini MAXALT (83); park = legacy control.telescope_park defaults (alt 25, az 0).
focus_min/focus_max (microns) = legacy telescope_N.ini MINFOCUS/MAXFOCUS (100/33000); ports = sites/minerva/instruments.json.
max_jog_deg: robofast-pwi-jog's largest relative move per axis (first hardware session: keep it small).
Only one of the PWI2 and PWI4 configs of a telescope runs at a time (same listen port); only one of PWI2 and PWI4 may own the mount.
name: t2
